index.html: The desktop's own page: the CSP allows its inline theme script by hash, held to tauri.conf.json by src-tauri/tests/bundle_config.rs.
src/main.tsx: Installs the desktop's link handling before the first render: matterwave:// links and the launch link, and links out of the app to the system browser.
src/lib/desktopAuth.ts: The platform's bridge to the desktop shell, extended with the desktop's commands and events: API key and device pairing in the OS keychain, the updater, notifications, launch at login, the global hotkey, the tray's recent chats.
src/lib/desktopAuth.test.ts: Tests for the desktop's additions to desktopAuth.ts.
src/lib/desktopAuth.notify.test.ts: Desktop only: the finished-answer notification through the bridge.
src/lib/desktopBilling.*: Desktop only: Stripe Checkout and the portal open in the system browser, and the page re-reads the subscription when the window comes back.
src/lib/desktopBridge.test.ts: Desktop only: every bridge call the SPA makes is one src-tauri/capabilities/default.json allows.
src/lib/desktopDev.*: Desktop only: the gate for the dev diagnostics pane (a dev build inside the shell).
src/lib/desktopLinks.*: Desktop only: links out of the app open in the system browser, not the webview.
src/lib/desktopNavigation.*: Desktop only: matterwave:// links, the menu and the tray routed into the SPA.
src/lib/webauthn.ts: Passkeys are off in the webview: its origin is not the provider's rpId, so a ceremony there can only fail.
src/lib/webauthn.desktop.test.ts: Desktop only: the webview's passkey gate.
src/shell/Shell.tsx: Registers the shell with the desktop's navigation (links, menu, tray), the menu's chords the webview keeps, the tray's recent chats, and the update banner.
src/shell/Shell.desktop.test.tsx: Desktop only: tests for the shell's desktop wiring.
src/shell/UserMenu.tsx: No account switcher in the desktop shell: parked accounts are browser cookies, desktop auth is one keychain credential.
src/shell/UserMenu.test.tsx: Tests for the desktop's account switcher gate.
src/apps/chat/speech.ts: The refused-microphone message points at the OS's privacy settings in the webview, which has no address bar; the wording follows isDesktop() by default, so the dictation hook stays the platform's.
src/apps/chat/speech.desktop.test.ts: Desktop only: the desktop wording of the refused microphone.
src/apps/chat/tts.*: Desktop only: read-aloud through the webview's speechSynthesis.
src/apps/chat/ReadAloudAction.tsx: Desktop only: the Read aloud button.
src/apps/chat/ChatPage.tsx: The chat adapter's onDone hook tells the native side a generation finished, so it can notify an unfocused window; read-aloud: one hook above the transcript, handed to each stored reply.
src/apps/chat/MessageControls.tsx: Read-aloud: the button in a reply's action row.
src/apps/chat/MessageControls.test.tsx: Tests for the read-aloud button in the action row.
src/apps/billing/PricingPage.tsx: Checkout opens in the system browser; the page shows the new plan when the window comes back.
src/apps/settings/panes/BillingPane.tsx: The billing portal opens in the system browser; the pane re-reads the status when the window comes back.
src/apps/settings/panes.ts: The dev diagnostics pane in the nav, in a dev build inside the shell only.
src/apps/settings/paneComponents.ts: The dev diagnostics pane's component, behind the same gate.
src/apps/settings/panes/DesktopPane.*: Desktop only: the dev diagnostics pane.
src/apps/settings/panes/AccountPane.*: An API key kept in the OS keychain, and passkeys added by way of the browser.
src/apps/settings/panes/DevicesPane.*: Pairing this machine as a device, against the API base rather than the webview's origin.
The global hotkey and launch at login.
